name: @lumine-code/bash-language-server
author: lumine-code
description: Bash language server maintained by lumine-code.

scripts.build: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.copyFileSync('server/src/get-options.sh', 'server/out/get-options.sh'); fs.chmodSync('server/out/get-options.sh', 0o755)" && prettier --write "server/out/**/*.js"
scripts.lint: eslint server/src testing scripts/*.js eslint.config.js vitest.config.mts --max-warnings 0
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json server/tsconfig.json server/src "testing/*.ts" scripts/*.js eslint.config.js vitest.config.mts .github README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json server/tsconfig.json server/src "testing/*.ts" scripts/*.js eslint.config.js vitest.config.mts .github README.md CHANGELOG.md
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:package
